findings.evidence: Lines 97–102 expose the definition body, while the only theorem mentioning `restProd` (lines 105–115) proves boundedness and does not state its value.

findings.evidence: Line 60 defines the alias; lines 63–79 provide positivity and period membership only, and both existing proofs access the defining equality via `simpa [cuspWidth]`.
findings.fix: Add a public `[simp]` theorem `cuspWidth_def : cuspWidth (Γ := Γ) = (G Γ).strictWidthInfty`.

summary: The main function definitions expose their bodies instead of providing characteristic equations, forcing downstream proofs to depend on implementation details.
